geometry_note: All ten are the identical 14-vertex rectangular box (same volume, area, footprint); only orientation differs.
texture_note: Ten distinct brand prints: cream/gold, maroon, red/gold, white/red text, floral, black tiger character, blue circle, red/white, DIAMOND blue, yellow.

geometry_note: Same tapered cylindrical cup mesh (7808 faces, identical volume/area) in all five; no shape differences.
texture_note: fyrkzs and zycgen share the same dark gunmetal texture; jdijek light grey, rhohgs pale blue-white, uobdoq grey with dark interior.

geometry_note: Same lemon mesh (2078 faces, identical volume/area) with near-identical vertex counts; same stem nub position.
texture_note: All four render as the same yellow lemon skin with a small green stem; thumb_dist differences not visible.

geometry_note: Identical flat ridged disc cap (544 faces, same volume/area); vertex counts differ only slightly.
texture_note: Same cream-white surface with identical bluish shading pattern in top-down view; swatches identical.

geometry_note: Same sunflower head and curved stem, identical bbox/volume/area; minor vertex-count differences only, stem projection varies with rotation.
texture_note: Identical yellow petals, dark brown centre and green stem; swatches identical.

geometry_note: Same long-neck beer bottle silhouette and cap; slightly different face count and 4% area difference, no visible shape change.
texture_note: kqskmv is dark brown glass, saslsh dark green glass; both carry the same cream sunburst/hexagon body and neck labels.

geometry_note: Identical bottle mesh (1920 faces, same volume/area): tall straight body, short neck.
texture_note: klbwkf is clear transparent glass; xkjyby is opaque cream/white with a red-gold label on the back.

geometry_note: Both plain rectangular Just For Men cartons; separately tessellated meshes with ~4% volume difference, no visible silhouette change.
texture_note: bclpiq red/orange box (Jet Black shade, dark-haired man); jccyom blue box (blond man) - different prints.

geometry_note: Same half-lime dome mesh (5216 faces, identical volume/area); vertex counts differ slightly.
texture_note: Both render as the same bright green rind with identical pore texture; swatches identical.

geometry_note: Same oval mouse shape with scroll wheel; ihpnjx is a low-poly (970-face) version of fjljxp, ~3% volume/area difference.
texture_note: Both render near-white with grey scroll wheel; white-on-white render and high thumb_dist leave texture details unverified.

geometry_note: Same flip-flop mesh (8832/8833 faces, identical volume/area, same strap anchor positions); vertex count differs from UV splitting.
texture_note: Both plain blue flip-flops with the same navy swatch; marginal brightness difference consistent with shading/UV seams.

geometry_note: Both standard Nintendo 3DS game cases; slightly different tessellation and 2% volume difference, same silhouette.
texture_note: ppnzqm is Pokemon X cover art (blue/white Xerneas); pujfzk is Animal Crossing New Leaf (green, colourful).
